new_written_claims: Every proper ancestor of a contact target has harmonic mass at most rho times the target mass.
The actual next-contact transport has finite strictly subinvariant reference sigma=nu^2 1_C.
Its original-source energy and total retained source mass contract geometrically in contact time.
Forward contact heights decay and inverse contact heights grow geometrically; logarithmic inverse-contact costs are summable.
For every finite nonnegative original source eta, R(1)S eta=S_T eta lies between delta S eta and S eta.
Tao marginal L1 mixing and density consistency imply a clipped maximal Haar L1 estimate; transfer to the actual stopped contact endpoint law remains OPEN.

Under the actual critical inverse law, D_(t-k)(X_k)/G(X_k) is a bounded martingale while its remaining density horizon is positive; stopping at tau wedge (s-m) gives the normalized comparison (6) with a displayed 4 chi entrance-tail term.
formal_scope: Finite weighted row algebra, finite disjoint source fibers, geometric iteration, and finite height inequalities. Analytic constructions, countable sums, inverse contact recurrence, and logarithmic series are written rather than formalized.
remaining_obligations: Control the full ordinary excursion durations and terminal escaping source mass.
Do not infer absorption from killing at the last contact or from decay in a height-weighted norm.
Periodic states and possible nontrivial cycles are outside this domain.
Prove the normalized stopped correlation estimate SM+ and separately control initial entrance and the last-contact eta boundary; the Haar maximal estimate is insufficient by itself.
